blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) will recommend to the Department of Justice (DOJ) the filing of obstruction of justice, cyber libel, and publication of false news complaints against former Davao City chief information officer Jefry Tupas. In an interview on Monday, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said the complaint referral came after the bureau finished its investigation report regarding Tupas, a former aide of Vice President Sara Duterte who is implicated in the “cash delivery” claims of dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. Gracioso is alleging that he handed over suitcases of money to Tupas for Duterte, an […]...
